semanticAssessment: Current native response provides useful source-grounded architectural triage. SDK, preview, licensing, root-span, ingestion, and authority distinctions are substantively correct. No mandatory narration correction.

findings.finding: Receipt and agent report used different evidence hash representations.
findings.cause: Receipt hashed JSON.stringify(parsedEvidence); agent report hashed original file bytes.
findings.remediation: Both now hash exact sources.json bytes, with an explicit receipt hashBasis. Bound text inputs use checkout-stable LF enforced by .gitattributes. Source receipts and the native model evaluation were regenerated.
findings.closure: Author-run exact-byte hash checks and the offline receipt regression test; not a second independent review.

findings.finding: A365-C01 and A365-C10 included source URLs without matching headings.
findings.remediation: C01 cites S01; C10 cites S09. All remaining multi-source claims have explicit sourceLocators maps. The source verifier checks each heading at its own URL.
findings.closure: Author-run public metadata/heading verification and offline per-source regression test; not a second independent review.

findings.finding: Do not suggest registry sync as an established Copilot Studio fallback.
findings.remediation: C05 and the profile explicitly require platform-specific eligibility and investigation of built-in enablement.
findings.closure: Revised source/profile bindings and a fresh five-case native model run.

limitations: Five keyword/citation cases are a smoke suite, not broad benchmark coverage.
The native response was semantically reviewed; tenant integration and real ingestion were not exercised.
The redacted telemetry helper checks declared fixture consistency, not actual tenant permissions, licensing, trace topology, or service health.
